The airport transfer follows the next morning.

itinerary.title: Met at Cairo International, hotel
itinerary.source: The tour begins quietly: you are met at Cairo International and taken to your hotel, no programme for the first evening.

itinerary.title: Old Cairo, Citadel, Khan el-Khalili
itinerary.source: The second day works a less-visited stratum than the pharaonic.

itinerary.title: Memphis, Saqqara and Dahshur
itinerary.source: Day three traces the oldest pyramid-building sequence that exists.

itinerary.title: Flight to Abu Simbel, then Aswan
itinerary.source: Day four is the longest in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: High Dam, Philae, boarding Nile cruise
itinerary.source: Day five moves between modern engineering and ancient stone.

itinerary.title: Cruise north: Kom Ombo and Edfu
itinerary.source: The cruise carries you north on day six, pausing at two river temples.

itinerary.title: Luxor West Bank, Valley of the Kings
itinerary.source: The cruise reaches Luxor, ancient Thebes, and the first Luxor day crosses to the land the Egyptians set aside for their dead.

itinerary.title: Karnak and Luxor Temple
itinerary.source: The second Luxor day stays on the living side.

itinerary.title: Drive across Eastern Desert to Hurghada
itinerary.source: Day nine changes register: you leave the Nile Valley and drive east across the Eastern Desert to Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Red Sea coral reef day
itinerary.source: The Red Sea holds one of the finest coral reef systems on earth, and day ten is the one to encounter it.

itinerary.title: Bedouin village afternoon, Eastern Desert
itinerary.source: The third Hurghada day turns inland: a Bedouin village afternoon takes you into the Eastern Desert on its own terms.

itinerary.title: Ferry south to Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.source: A ferry on day twelve carries you south to Sharm El Sheikh, at the tip of the Sinai Peninsula — more developed and international than Hurghada, its diving reputation reaching beyond Egypt.

itinerary.title: Sharm full day, no fixed programme
itinerary.source: Sharm then gets two full days without a fixed programme: reef, beaches, dive schools, markets, or excursions into the Sinai interior.

itinerary.title: Sharm full day, no fixed programme
itinerary.source: Sharm then gets two full days without a fixed programme: reef, beaches, dive schools, markets, or excursions into the Sinai interior.

itinerary.title: Return to Cairo, Sound and Light
itinerary.source: Day sixteen returns you to Cairo, the drive timed for the Sound and Light Show at Giza — the plateau flood-lit, the Sphinx narrating its own history.

itinerary.title: Pyramids of Giza, Grand Egyptian Museum
itinerary.source: Day seventeen is the one many travellers have been building toward since Saqqara.

itinerary.title: Airport transfer
itinerary.source: The airport transfer follows the next morning.
